subject: Film & Cinema
title: Foley: The Art of Fake Sounds
description: A micro-lesson that makes Foley: The Art of Fake Sounds usable.

hook.text: The footsteps you hear in a movie were made by someone walking on a studio floor weeks later.

buildup.text: Foley artists recreate everyday sounds — footsteps, doors, fabric — in post-production.

discovery.text: Real sounds recorded on set often sound thin or wrong. Foley makes them feel right.

twist.text: A coconut becomes a horse gallop. Celery snapping becomes a bone breaking.

climax.text: Foley is invisible when done well — you should never notice it.

punchline.text: The most realistic sounds are completely fake.
